reviewer: root Codex; primary pages personally read via web

sources.title: IO-Lite: A Unified I/O Buffering and Caching System
sources.version: TOCS18(1), February2000; earlier OSDI1998 version is distinct
sources.covers: Immutable unified cache/I/O payload referenced across protected users, ACL pools and ref-count reclamation; cache policy accounts current use and recency.
sources.not_established: Exact late own-IOMMU grant, word-level AXI heldVALID pin/cut and one-suffix response contract not established by these sections.

sources.title: Advanced Software Framework, Tools, and Languages for the IXP Family
sources.version: Intel Technology Journal2003 vol7 issue4, PDFpp64–65
sources.covers: Multicast parent payload stored once; child references retire parent when final child transmits.
sources.not_established: No retrieved exact independent IOMMU success/prefix protocol.

sources.title: When Fancy Eviction Fails: Rethinking Cache Replacement For LLM Prefix Reuse
sources.covers: Physical residency can be independent of prefix matching. Partial contiguous eviction avoids fragmentation. Evaluation models all request blocks resident at prefill.
sources.not_established: LLM KV dependencies and prefill differ from streaming DMA. Does not establish our exact AXI pin/recovery or permission/PTW ordering rule. Generic partial-prefix retention alone is a poor novelty claim.

sources.title: Preserving Admission Responsibility in Multi-Tenant Large Language Model Prefix Caches
sources.covers: Admission debt gates reuse protection and chooses responsible group for eviction; free shared capacity remains work-conserving.
sources.not_established: Does not establish our native own-permission/result-owner/AXI lifecycle. Do not label shared borrowing or responsibility accounting broadly new.

sources.title: Scheduling Page Table Walks for Irregular GPU Applications
sources.covers: Batch most recently served SIMD instruction; otherwise select least instruction-wide PWC-estimated walk work, ties oldest; aging override.
sources.not_established: Inspected selection does not use actual shared payload last-owner retirement. Missing input alone is not an end-to-end gain or novelty proof.

sources.title: MASK: Redesigning the GPU Memory Hierarchy to Support Multi-Application Concurrency
sources.covers: Prioritize translation FIFO; data Silver quota uses concurrent PTWs and stalled-warps-per-miss; FR-FCFS for data queues.
sources.not_established: No actual shared payload hard-owner-mask or final-W reference release in the inspected score. Must retain translation priority/stalled-count as controls.

sources.title: Multicast Scheduling for Input-Queued Switches
sources.covers: Residue concentration retires more complete multicast HOL cells; WBA combines age and negative fanout, and discusses queue occupancy variations.
sources.not_established: No delayed independent authorization/PTW stage in the inspected crossbar model. Generic last-child release and grouping principles cannot be claimed new; compare a concrete stage-aware extension before claiming a contribution.

judgement: Shared immutable payload/refcount and generic partial reclaim are covered primitives. Concrete same-pool control equivalence independently defeats the claimed unique6-cell gain. Exact unpublished protocol firstness is separate from having a useful main contribution. Next positive design targets permit scheduling by actual last-reference release rather than another duplicate-cache layout.
execution: primary reads and root architecture reasoning; no claims of autonomous worker browsing or new DUT result
